findings.summary: The "7d" preset was not updated to match the off-by-one fix applied to 30d/90d.
findings.mechanism: `"7d": { from: () => daysAgo(7), ... }` still uses daysAgo(7) while 30d/90d were changed to daysAgo(29)/daysAgo(89) (n-1). With `to` = today and an inclusive SQL window, daysAgo(7) still spans 8 calendar days, so "Last 7 days" remains broken exactly as described in the task brief, while 30d/90d are fixed.
